name: Southern Medical Services of New Orleans, Inc
old_description: The most trusted name in medical equipment repair for over 50 years
about:
Southern Medical Services of New Orleans, Inc. (SMSNO) has operated from Slidell, Louisiana since its founding in 1975. The company is a family-run business that began as a medical equipment repair provider and has expanded to serve laboratories and hospitals nationwide.

The firm specializes in medical equipment repair, offering onsite service for repair, safety inspections, and equipment checks. It also sells and leases medical equipment with lease-to-own options. In addition, SMSNO designs, fabricates, and installs custom laboratory fume venting systems tailored to client specifications.

Its customer base consists primarily of medical laboratories and hospitals across the United States. The company has maintained a presence in the sector for decades, holding membership in the Medical Equipment Repair Associates (MERA) since 1975.

SMSNO emphasizes its family-owned structure and long-standing MERA affiliation as markers of reliability. The ability to provide both repair services and custom-built ventilation systems under one roof allows it to address a range of laboratory infrastructure needs.
